# MediaPipe

- `vision_bundle.js` and `wasm/` are from the npm package `@mediapipe/tasks-vision` 1.0.1.
- `models/face_landmarker.task` (float16, version 1) and `models/selfie_segmenter_landscape.tflite` (float16, version 1) are from https://storage.googleapis.com/mediapipe-models/.
